changes: Derived from long 5.3.2 with existing bit arithmetic and optional WebAssembly acceleration.
Validate complete integer strings and radices, with bounded two-word or BigInt accumulation for arbitrarily long input.
Use native string conversion; preserve signed/unsigned wrapping.
Remove mutable small-integer caches and freeze shared constants.
Require exactly eight valid bytes; include Uint8Array declarations.
Self-contained declarations and common CommonJS/native ESM default entry.

implementation.basis: The package retains upstream two-word arithmetic and optional WebAssembly acceleration, with parsing and validation changes. The arithmetic runtime is not independently rewritten.
implementation.targetScope: 64-bit values, conversions and operations reached by protobufjs, proto-loader and Firestore message types.
implementation.remainingWork: Independently implement the required 64-bit value operations and conversions, preserving wire compatibility and existing strict input/caching fixes.
